## Evidence and validation

- [ ] Changes are additive; existing device knowledge and reports are preserved.
- [ ] The report distinguishes observed facts, user-provided information, and recommendations.
- [ ] Before/after data was collected under comparable conditions, where applicable.
- [ ] Commands, package states, and results are documented accurately; no test is claimed without evidence.
- [ ] Relevant validation scripts / CI checks were run, or the reason they could not be run is stated.
- [ ] Catalogs and indexes were updated when required.

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] The device owner explicitly authorized any device-changing action described.
- [ ] All submitted data was reviewed and sanitized.
- [ ] No IMEI, serial number, MAC address, private IP, account identifier, personal notification, token, credential, or other sensitive data is included.
- [ ] No raw dumps or private logs are included unless specifically required, sanitized, and justified.
- [ ] Recommendations are device/build-specific and do not imply universal safety.
